input.title: Aventon Level 4 REC
input.descriptionHtml:
New Aventon Level 4 REC ebike Step Over & Step-Through in stock. 750W hub motor, up to 75-mile range, regenerative braking, 4G/GPS, rack and fenders included. $1,999 + $160 assembly & tuning.

Aventon Level 4 REC
750W Hub Motor, Regen Braking, 75-Mile Range

 

The Aventon Level 4 REC is a purpose-built commuter and recreational ebike that pairs a 750W rear hub motor (1,188W peak; 1,440W in Boost Mode) with a 733Wh removable lithium-ion battery for up to 75 miles of range on a charge. Regenerative braking captures energy on descents and during deceleration, adding approximately 10 miles of range and reducing brake pad wear. The Level 4 REC ships Class 2 with throttle included, and is convertible to Class 3. Both the Step Over and Step-Through frames are in stock at Quest Watersports in Ottawa, IL, each available in Regular and Large sizing.

The 6061 aluminum frame pairs with an 80mm travel coil-spring suspension fork and a 50mm travel suspension seatpost for all-day comfort on pavement and packed surfaces. Tektro HD-E3520 2-piston hydraulic disc brakes with e-cutoff handle stopping duties, and a Shimano Altus 8-speed drivetrain keeps shifting simple. The connected platform includes 4G/GPS tracking, an integrated rear wheel e-lock, unusual activity detection and alarm, and Apple Watch compatibility via the Aventon app. Note: 4G connectivity is complimentary for the first year; a paid subscription is required after that period.

**E-Bikes are subject to a $160 assembly & tuning fee** 

Frame styles & fit:

  • Step Over Matte Black or Matte Storm Blue Regular (5'3" - 5'10") / Large (5'10" - 6'4")
  • Step-Through Glacier Mint or Sandstone Regular (4'11" - 5'7") / Large (5'7" - 6'1") 442mm standover height


Included with every Level 4 REC:

  • Rear rack (integrated)
  • Full fenders, front and rear (integrated)
  • Integrated front and rear lights
  • Throttle
  • 42V 4A charger
  • 9/16" composite platform pedals
  • Aventon suspension seatpost (50mm travel)

Specs:
Motor 750W Rear Hub (1,188W Peak / 1,440W Boost)
Motor Torque 80Nm (96Nm in Boost Mode)
Battery 36V, 20Ah, 733Wh Removable Internal, LG 21700 cells
Range Up to 75 miles (est.)
Charge Time 5 hours (0 - 100%)
Frame 6061 Aluminum Step Over or Step-Through
Step Over Colors Matte Black, Matte Storm Blue
Step-Through Colors Glacier Mint, Sandstone
Step Over Fit Regular 5'3" - 5'10" / Large 5'10" - 6'4"
Step-Through Fit Regular 4'11" - 5'7" / Large 5'7" - 6'1"
Fork 80mm Travel Coil Spring, Preload Adj., Lockout
Wheels 27.5" Double Wall Aluminum
Tires Kenda Kwick Seven-5 Sport 27.5" x 2.2"
Brakes Tektro HD-E3520 2-Piston Hydraulic Disc w/ E-Cutoff, 180mm rotors
Drivetrain Shimano Altus 8-Speed, 1232T Cassette, 48T Chainring
Display Aventon A280
Smart Features Regenerative Braking, 4G/GPS, E-Lock, Activity Alarm, Ride Tune, Hold Mode
Ebike Class Class 2 (Convertible to Class 1 or 3)
Weight 68.5 lbs
Weight Capacity 330 lbs
Water Resistance IPX5 (bike) / IPX6 (components)
Safety Cert. UL 2849 Certified
Price $1,999 + $160 assembly & tuning ($2,159 total) + tax


Come see them in person. Both frame styles are typically on the floor at Quest Watersports

Call 815.433.2200 or email ebikes@questwatersports.com to confirm specific availability or arrange a test ride.
